Bill.BriefDescription: Concerning the slaughter, preparation, and sale of certain poultry.

BillBody.BillTitle: AN ACT Relating to poultry; amending RCW 69.07.100; adding a newsection to chapter 43.20 RCW; and adding a new section to chapter 16.49RCW.
BillBody.EnactingClause: BE IT ENACTED BY THE LEGISLATURE OF THE STATE OF WASHINGTON:

BegSecNew.BegSecText: A new section is added to chapter 43.20 RCWto read as follows:

BillSection.RCWSLText: Rules adopted by the state board of health, the department ofhealth, or a local health jurisdiction, as defined in RCW 43.70.575,regulating food or food service establishments do not apply to theslaughter and preparation of one thousand or fewer pastured poultryanimals in a calendar year by the agricultural producer of the poultryfor the sale of the whole raw poultry by the producer directly to theultimate consumer at the producer's farm. The state board of health,the department of health, or a local health jurisdiction, as defined inRCW 43.70.575, shall not apply such rules directly or indirectly tosuch an activity or sale.

BegSecNew.BegSecText: A new section is added to chapter 16.49 RCWto read as follows:

BillSection.RCWSLText: This chapter does not apply to the slaughter and preparation of onethousand or fewer pastured poultry animals in a calendar year by theagricultural producer of the poultry for the sale of the whole rawpoultry by the producer directly to the ultimate consumer at theproducer's farm.

BegSecAmd.BegSecText: RCW 69.07.100 and 2002 c 301 s 10 are each amended to readas follows:

BillSection.RCWSLText: (1) The provisions of this chapter shall not apply toestablishments issued a permit or licensed under the provisions of: (((1))) (a) Chapter 69.25 RCW, the Washington wholesome eggs andegg products act; (((2))) (b) Chapter 69.28 RCW, the Washington state honey act; (((3))) (c) Chapter 16.49 RCW, the meat inspection act; (((4))) (d) Chapter 77.65 RCW, relating to the direct retailendorsement for wildcaught seafood; (((5))) (e) Title 66 RCW, relating to alcoholic beverage control;and (((6))) (f) Chapter 69.30 RCW, the sanitary control of shellfishact. However, if any such establishments process foods notspecifically provided for in the above entitled acts, suchestablishments shall be subject to the provisions of this chapter. (2) The provisions of this chapter shall not apply to: (a) Restaurants or food service establishments; and (b) The slaughter and preparation of one thousand or fewer pasturedpoultry animals in a calendar year by the agricultural producer of thepoultry for the sale of the whole raw poultry by the producer directlyto the ultimate consumer at the producer's farm when: (i) The poultry appears to be healthy, free from disease or injury; (ii) All processing facilities, equipment, and utensils are kept ina clean and sanitary condition; (iii) Personnel working with the product adhere to hygienicpractices and are free, or appear to be free, of infectious disease oropen lesions; (iv) The product is protected from contamination at all times; and (v) The producer registers with the department, keeps a record ofpurchasers of the product for one year, and makes the records available SHB 1754 p. 2 to the department, upon request, to assist in the traceback of publichealth issues.
